description: This file contains the definition of the 'Country' model class used in the admin area of an OpenCart project. It provides methods for managing country records in the database, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving countries and their descriptions. It interacts with database tables for countries and descriptions and relies on external database and cache components.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: A class that manages country-related data in the OpenCart admin module, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving country records and descriptions.

methods.name: addCountry
methods.description: Creates a new country record in the database, including inserting country details and descriptions, then clears the country cache.

methods.name: editCountry
methods.description: Updates an existing country record and its descriptions in the database, then clears the cache.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (enabled/disabled) of a specific country record, then clears the cache.

methods.name: deleteCountry
methods.description: Removes a country record and its descriptions from the database and clears the cache.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific country, including its description in the current language.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode2
methods.description: Fetches country details based on the ISO code 2.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode3
methods.description: Fetches country details based on the ISO code 3.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of countries based on optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCountries
methods.description: Returns the total count of countries matching optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalCountriesByAddressFormatId
methods.description: Counts how many countries are associated with a specific address format.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Inserts a new description for a country in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a given country.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific language across all countries.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of a country in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a country in all languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all country descriptions in a specific language.
